researchNotes: Upgrade options are community-reported compatibility references, not confirmed distinct inventory items or combinations. No recipe, cost, prerequisite or mutually exclusive path inferred.

2026-10-13 cross-check: Kettle Anti-Shield, Il Toro More Reload, Aphelion Bigger Mag and Increased Burst added as unverified community options. Equalizer Anti Shield and Rascal/Hullcracker Incendiary Grenade flagged as disputed pending primary-source validation.
2026-10-13 full weapon inventory audit: 26 weapons on ARC Raiders Wiki, 15 community-listed Amplified; other 11 remain explicit unconfirmed/launch-unsupported, not silently omitted.
Community game-file guide provides preliminary tree dependencies and exclusions; source is not an official game-data export. Verify in-game before presenting as certain.

2026-10-13: Corrected four provisional prerequisite directions against guide's per-weapon table; added screenshot-anchored partial research costs and two weapon preview stat sets, without filling other unknown variant costs.

2026-10-13: Japanese 15-family repair table and Reddit first-hand 13-research player report cross-checked; base repair figures agree by rarity, Equalizer 54 example agrees with maximum; no per-variant repair costs inferred.

2026-10-13 ARC Tracker game-version 2.00 item index independently exposes many combined Amplified weapon configurations, and contradicts some option labels. Avoid asserting the existing 45 nodes are 45 distinct variants.

2026-10-13: ARC Tracker publicly renders individual Hullcracker node recipes and prerequisite, and explicit Kettle/Hullcracker/Jupiter amplification inputs. These are database-backed partial verification, not visually checked in-game screenshots.

findings: All 15 families have named Amplified base records and many multi-perk configuration records in ARC Tracker item index.
Equalizer index has base, Ramping Damage, Anti-Weak Point, Bigger Mag, Ramping Damage + Bigger Mag, Anti-Weak Point + Bigger Mag; no Anti Shield variant shown in indexed Equalizer records.
Hullcracker and Rascal item records use Incendiary Rounds; conflicts with earlier Incendiary Grenade label.
Jupiter and Osprey records use Ergonomic Bolt; conflicts with prior Straight Bolt naming.
Kettle database includes Anti-Shield + Full-Auto, so blanket mutual exclusion between Anti-Shield and Full-Auto would be incorrect.
Some configurations have three or four simultaneous perks; 45 nodes cannot be equated to variant count.
